input.lugar: Plaza de Armas of Arequipa, Peru, seen from inside one of its white sillar stone arcades (portales)
input.escena: from the shade of the white volcanic-stone arcade, the bright plaza with palm trees opens outside and, far behind, the cone of El Misti volcano rises against a clean blue sky; a woman traveler walks along the arcade toward the light, at medium distance. It must read as a historic centre of white volcanic stone, not any colonial plaza
input.hora: close to midday with the sun high over the sillar
input.clima: clear sky, open shadows inside the arcade, highlights of the white stone and sky retained
input.primerPlano: the edge of a white sillar arcade column
input.refLugar: the Plaza de Armas of Arequipa: its cathedral, palm trees and the position and shape of El Misti behind it
input.prohibir: snow on El Misti not present in the reference, changing the real proportion or position of the volcano relative to the plaza, readable shop signs
input.extra: SKY BRANDLIFT CONSISTENCY (Daniela Ferreira, SKY Blog visual system, sheet 15): believable traveler POV at eye height; luminous natural light with open shadows and whites that keep detail; natural colour where ochres, blues and skin keep their true tones, moderate contrast, no filter, no orange-teal grade, no HDR; real optical depth: the near element very out of focus with soft optical bokeh, the subject sharp; a spontaneous everyday moment, no pose. LENS: 28–35 mm equivalent, contextual and immersive.
